g.text: Lists local branches sorted by commit date, showing the relative time since the last commit.
lists git branches sorted by the date of their last commit
find . -name "*.rs" -type f -print0 | xargs -0 stat -c '%Y %n' | sort -nr | head -n 10 | cut -d ' ' -f 2-
Finds all .rs files, uses stat to get modification time and filename, sorts numerically by time (newest first), and displays the top 10 filenames.
shows the 10 most recently modified rust files
Recursively and forcefully removes the result-lib directory and its contents.
DANGEROUS (recursive/forced delete (rm -r/-f)). Type 'run' to execute anyway
